interface.name: zwwm_layer_shell_v1
interface.description: Assigns a layer role to an uncommitted wl_surface. Layers are ordered background, bottom, top, overlay. Ordinary windows lie between bottom and top. Each layer surface belongs to an output, chosen by the compositor when output is null. The initial wl_surface commit must have no buffer; the client must wait for configure and acknowledge it before mapping.

interface.name: zwwm_layer_surface_v1
interface.description: Size, anchors, exclusive zone, margins, keyboard mode, and layer are applied together on wl_surface.commit. A null buffer unmaps the surface; remapping requires another bufferless commit and configure exchange. A zero dimension requires anchors on both opposite edges of that axis. Positive exclusive zones reserve space when anchored to one edge (or that edge and both perpendicular edges). Zone zero avoids reserved space; zone -1 permits extending underneath it.
